title: Fear Of The Future
paragraphs: “Still… Naofumi is really good at taking care of Filolials.”
“He’s always been good at looking after others. Didn’t you think so when you first met him?”
“Yeah. He’s got a smooth way of talking, but at the same time, he’s not afraid to approach anyone. Plus, he likes to have fun, so naturally, he’s good at taking care of others.”
At that moment, Éclair cut into Ren and Itsuki’s conversation.
“I agree. Among the Heroes, he’s the easiest to talk to. Next would be Kawasumi-dono.”
“Itsuki gives off a calm first impression.”
“The way you said that makes it sound like I’m actually a terrible person inside.”

“Looking at what’s happened so far, it’s clear you have a strong sense of justice. From what Motoyasu has told us, that same justice-driven mindset has even caused problems for you, and for me as well.”
“…That’s true. I can’t deny that I wanted to vent my frustrations from before the summoning by taking them out in this world.”
“I was the same. I wanted to become the strongest.”
Ren and Itsuki both let out a long sigh at the same time. They seem to have some lingering trauma about it.
“Naofumi is incredibly talented, but he never comes across as arrogant about it.”
“Being around him made us realize things about ourselves, too.”
“His biggest flaw is how he meddles too much in other people’s love lives. If it weren’t for that, people might actually call him annoying.”
“Using even his flaws to get closer to people… Now that’s a true Hero. Although, he does have other shortcomings too.”
“Like what?”
“He’s a man.”
“…Yeah. If he were a woman, we’d probably have fallen for him by now.”
“Hah…”
“Hahaha…”
Ren and Itsuki let out dry, awkward laughter.
“I’d advise against too much self-deprecation. Amaki-dono, Kawasumi-dono, you both have plenty of strengths, too.”
“Spare us the flattery.”

“But Iwatani-dono himself praised you both—Amaki-dono for your keen analytical skills, and Kawasumi-dono for your strong sense of justice. No matter what happens in the future, the two of you now are different from who you used to be, aren’t you?”
“…Yeah. I guess we’ve been feeling down because Naofumi is just too good at taking care of others. He’s practically built for it.”
“Exactly. But we must have talents of our own, too. We just need to keep pushing forward.”
As I listened in on their conversation, I continued playing with the Filolials. Of course, I wasn’t holding back. Playing with the Filolials is the greatest joy in life, after all.
“Motoyasu-kun, try easing up just enough that they feel like they almost have a chance of winning—but don’t let them notice you’re doing it.”
“Kweeehh!!”
“Yuki-chan, if you go up against Motoyasu-kun at full power, you’ll never win. Just keep putting in the effort little by little, okay?”
Yuki-chan is noble no matter the world. She’s probably frustrated that I’m holding back for her.
“By the way… aren’t we going to talk about Kitamura-dono’s strengths and weaknesses?”
I feel like Ren and Itsuki are staring at me. When I turned my head to look at them, they quickly averted their gazes.
“He’s a reckless fool who never thinks ahead.”
“Yeah. He’s the kind of person who, once he decides to believe in someone, will charge forward without question.”
“That kind of sounds like a protagonist, doesn’t it?”
“Well, he is a Hero, so I guess he’s basically like a protagonist. If the people around the original Motoyasu had been different, things might have turned out much better for him. What do you think?”
“Yeah… But the ones he trusted were that kingdom’s princess and king…”
What’s this now? Are we talking about the crimson swine and that Trash?

“You know how it is—the kind of story where a betrayed comrade actually had a reason for their actions, and the protagonist believes in them until the very end. In the end, their bond becomes even stronger.”
“A classic trope. I’ve seen it in manga before.”
“So basically, if you trust the wrong person, you end up like that…”
“…Yeah, pretty much.”
Hmm, are they talking about me? The ones I believe in are Father and Filo-tan. As long as I trust and follow Father, glory will surely shine upon us.
“In a way, as long as Naofumi takes care of it, there won’t be any problems.”
“Yes, we should leave it to Naofumi-san.”
“But still, he’s not someone Naofumi alone can handle…”
“I don’t want to know what happened in the future, but I am curious how he ended up with that kind of personality.”
Ren, Itsuki, and Éclair’s discussion was heating up.
“Apparently, he wasn’t always like that.”
“But maybe he had the potential for it?”
“Hmm… A man who will believe in you no matter what… From a woman’s perspective, that might make him a good man.”
“On the flip side, that just makes him a convenient man for women. He was probably warped because of the people around him.”
“From what I hear, he spent a lot of time with that princess—the one who enjoys trapping people and laughing at their misery.”
“He even bragged about how he was betrayed and fell into despair, only to be comforted by the Filolial that Naofumi-san raised. That must’ve been when something inside him snapped.”
“Kitamura-dono was already a man who loved deeply. Isn’t it the kind of love where you chase after someone? I’ve only read about it in stories, though.”
Oh! Éclair is saying something good. A love where you chase after someone… I am chasing after Filo-tan. There’s no turning back on this path.
I’ll charge straight ahead, like a spear!
“Even so, his situation is pretty extreme.”
“Our weapons apparently have cursed versions that can influence our personalities. Maybe he had good compatibility with one and it took hold?”
“From what Kitamura-dono says, in the first world he was in, not only Iwatani-dono, but also Amaki-dono and Kawasumi-dono seemed to have some serious personality issues.”
“Haaah…”
“Sigh…”
Meanwhile, we continued playing various games. Father was teaching Sakura-chan how to give a paw.

Is Sakura-chan a dog? Now that I think about it, I remember seeing Filo-tan go home when Father told her, “House!” I also recall him giving commands like “Attack!”, “Fall back!”, and “Double!” to other monsters, making them form up according to his orders. Though, he rarely made the Filolials do such things.
“Alright! Let’s all try to grab the stick on Motoyasu-kun’s head!”
Father came up with a new game.
Now we can all play together! I ran desperately, trying to escape from Yuki-chan and the others.
“Alright! The hunt begins!”
“Que!” “Que!” “Que!”
Oh… Being chased by Yuki-chan and the others…
Is this heaven?
I must savor every second of this!
“Come on, come this far if you can!”
“Yuki-chan, go straight ahead! Kou, Sakura-chan, circle around!”
With laughter and excitement, our game of tag continued. Time passed in our merriment, and before I knew it, the night had grown late.
“Hey, Naofumi! How long are you planning to play?”
Ren called out loudly to Father.
“Ah, right. Guess it’s time to head back?”
“Que!”
Yuki-chan and the others chirped contentedly, seemingly satisfied.
“I’m still not done playing!”
“Motoyasu-kun, try to control your inner child a little. And seriously, why are you the one throwing a tantrum?”
“Also… I was hoping I’d finally get to see them turn human.”
“It’s Motoyasu, so it can’t be helped. I’m sure in his eyes, they already look human.”
Ren said something rather rude.
That’s not true! Filolials are angels!
“Yuki-chan, Kou, Sakura-chan! If you don’t mind, could you show your angelic forms now?”
“Que?” “Que?” “Que?”
As I clasped my hands in prayer, Yuki-chan and the others nodded in response. Their feathers fluffed up, and they began transforming into their angelic forms.
“Whoa.”
“That’s kinda bright.”
With a soft glow, Yuki-chan and the others changed form.
“Motoyasu-sama!”
“That was so much fun!”
Yuki-chan and Kou cheerfully raised their hands and started speaking.
What an utterly heartwarming sight! Now then, all that’s left is Sakura-chan. I turned my gaze to Sakura-chan, who was standing near Father, and—
“Naofumi~”
With a relaxed tone…
Sakura-chan, looking just as young as last time, leaped at Father.
“Whoa!”
Yes… For some reason, Sakura-chan had taken on the appearance of a little girl.
